# Functions of qiime2R

read_qza() - Function for reading artifacts (.qza).

qza_to_phyloseq() - Imports multiple artifacts to produce a phyloseq object.

read_q2metadata() - Reads qiime2 metadata file (containing q2-types definition line).

write_q2manifest() - Writes a read manifest file to import data into qiime2.

theme_q2r() - A ggplot2 theme for publication-type figures.

print_provenance() - A function to display provenance information.

is_q2metadata() - A function to check if a file is a qiime2 metadata file.

parse_taxonomy() - A function to parse taxonomy strings and return a table where each column is a taxonomic class.

parse_ordination() - A function to parse the internal ordination format.

# Nomenclature

The manuscript and code files may utilize different naming conventions for groups and treatments as follows:

**Manuscript Name**  | **Related Script Name(s)**
------------- | -------------
Sample Type  | Type
Microbial Depletion  | Depletion, Dep, or Treatment
Microbial Density  | Concentration, Con, PW_Percentage, or Percentage
Pond Source | Pond, or Pond_Treatment

# Data Descriptions

## Full Dataset
This is the full dataset of all samples including water inoculation control/source samples, water samples from Week 4 Day 0 and water samples from Week 4 Day 6 for both control (uninhabited) and inhabited tanks, skin samples, and gut samples, after running decontam and rarefying to a depth of 30 reads. Kit control samples and PCR blanks have been removed. Here, we first run ADONIS to test "Type", a categorical factor of three levels: "Gut", "Skin", and "Water", to determine whether samples statistically cluster by Sample Type ("Type").


## Data Subsets {.tabset}

We then subset the data into the following groups for the purpose of ADONIS:

### Water Subsets
Water data subsets include only water samples from inhabited tanks, sampled on Week 4 Day 6.

Water - Depletion Groups (data subset directory "core-metrics-results-water-dep")
* 0% ("LW") Untreated ("U") samples
* 25% ("PLE" or "PM") Untreated ("U") samples
* 25% ("PLE" or "PM") Autoclaved ("A") samples
* 25% ("PLE" or "PM") Filtered ("F") samples

Water - Concentration Groups (data subset directory "core-metrics-results-water-con")
* 1%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% ("PLE" or "PM") Untreated ("U") samples


### Gut and Skin Subsets
Gut - Depletion Groups (data subset directory "core-metrics-results-gut-dep")
* 0% ("LW") Untreated ("U") samples
* 25% ("PLE" or "PM") Untreated ("U") gut samples
* 25% ("PLE" or "PM") Autoclaved ("A") gut samples
* 25% ("PLE" or "PM") Filtered ("F") gut samples
Gut - Concentration Groups (data subset directory "core-metrics-results-gut-con")
* 1%, 25%, 50%, and 100% ("PLE" or "PM") Untreated ("U") gut samples
Skin - Depletion Groups (data subset directory "core-metrics-results-skin-dep")
* 0% ("LW") Untreated ("U") skin samples
* 25% ("PLE" or "PM") Untreated ("U") skin samples
* 25% ("PLE" or "PM") Autoclaved ("A") skin samples
* 25% ("PLE" or "PM") Filtered ("F") skin samples
Skin - Concentration Groups (data subset directory "core-metrics-results-skin-con")
* 1%, 25%, 50%^¥^, and 100% ("PLE" or "PM") Untreated ("U") skin samples
  ^¥ 50% group is not present for PLE tadpole skin comparisons^
  
## Metadata Variable Descriptions

In the ADONIS formulas the following metadata variables are tested for depletion comparisons:

**Variable Name**  | **Description**
------------- | -------------
Treatment  | Categorical factor of 3 levels: A, F, U
Pond  | Categorical factor of 3 levels: LW, PLE, PM

*Note: We did not include percentage as a variable in these comparison as it resulted in 0 DF and -Inf F, and does not explain any additional variation.*

In the ADONIS formulas the following metadata variables are tested for concentration comparisons:

**Variable Name**  | **Description**
------------- | -------------
Pond  | Categorical factor of 2 levels: PLE, PM
Percentage  | Numeric factor of 3-5 levels: 1, 25, 50^¥^, 75^†^, 100
  ^¥ 50% group is not present for PLE tadpole skin comparisons^
  ^† 75% group is only present for water samples^

```{r seed, include=FALSE}
# SET SEED
set.seed(745869)
## This will allow others to reproduce your exact ADONIS numbers.
```

# ADONIS Results {.tabset} 

## Full Dataset

```{r Adonis2 all}
### TEST BY SAMPLE TYPE
### Import bray curtis distance matrix exported from QIIME2
bray_all <- read.table(file = '/core-metrics-results-decontam-d500-sampletype/exported_alpha/bray_curtis/distance-matrix.tsv', header = TRUE)
### Convert to data matrix
bray_all = data.matrix(bray_all)
### Import metadata file
metadata_all = read_q2metadata("Tadpole_Metadata_SampleType_Q2.txt")

### Run adonis to test whether samples statistically differ by "Type"
adonis2(bray_all ~ Type, data = metadata_all, permutations = 100000)

### Do the same for Jaccard
jacc_all <- read.table(file = '/core-metrics-results-decontam-d500-sampletype/exported_alpha/jaccard/distance-matrix.tsv',header = TRUE)
jacc_all = data.matrix(jacc_all)
metadata_all = read_q2metadata("Tadpole_Metadata_SampleType_Q2.txt")

adonis2(jacc_all ~ Type, data = metadata_all, permutations = 100000)
```

## Water Samples {.tabset .tabset-pills}

### Depletion

```{r Adonis2 water dep}
bray_water_dep=read.table(file = '/core-metrics-results-water-dep/exported_alpha/bray_curtis/distance-matrix.tsv',
                    sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
bray_water_dep=data.matrix(bray_water_dep)
jaccard_water_dep=read.table(file = '/core-metrics-results-water-dep/exported_alpha/jaccard/distance-matrix.tsv',
                    sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
jaccard_water_dep=data.matrix(jaccard_water_dep)
metadata_water_dep<-read_q2metadata("/core-metrics-results-water-dep/Tadpole_Metadata_Water_Qiime2R_Dep.txt")

#### Jaccard ADONIS
adonis2(jaccard_water_dep ~ Treatment + Pond, data = metadata_water_dep, by = "margin", permutations = 100000)
#### Bray Curtis ADONIS
adonis2(bray_water_dep ~ Treatment + Pond, data = metadata_water_dep, by = "margin", permutations = 100000)
```

### Concentration
```{r Adonis2 water con}
bray_water_con=read.table(file = '/core-metrics-results-water-con/exported_alpha/bray_curtis/distance-matrix.tsv',
                    sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
bray_water_con=data.matrix(bray_water_con)
jaccard_water_con=read.table(file = '/core-metrics-results-water-con/exported_alpha/jaccard/distance-matrix.tsv',
                    sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
jaccard_water_con=data.matrix(jaccard_water_con)
metadata_water_con<-read_q2metadata("/core-metrics-results-water-con/Tadpole_Metadata_Water_Qiime2R_Con.txt")

#### Jaccard ADONIS
adonis2(jaccard_water_con ~ Percentage + Pond, data = metadata_water_con, by = "margin", permutations = 100000)
#### Bray Curtis ADONIS
adonis2(bray_water_con ~ Percentage + Pond, data = metadata_water_con, by = "margin", permutations = 100000)
```
